conda_recipe_patches.effect: src/fparams.c:125 and :296 only (residue_string pointer fix in the -P/--custom_pocket branch); no default, option table or getopt string changes

source.note: Line references are to the unpatched 4.2.3 tag tarball above. The patch changes no line counts.

option_parsing.unknown_options: silently ignored (opterr = 0 and the switch has no default case, src/fparams.c:162-395); exit 0 alone therefore does not prove an option was applied
option_parsing.short_A_absent: 'A' is not in the getopt string (src/fparams.c:158); short -A is ignored. The long option number_apol_asph_pocket maps to 'A' (src/fparams.c:139) and is handled by case M_PAR_MIN_APOL_NEIGH (src/fparams.c:377-381).
option_parsing.installed_build_check: Installed bin/fpocket (sha256 a79058e4...2894) ran the argv above with exit 0 on the probe protein.pdb (2026-09-28).

src/refine.c:129 (pocket dropped if fewer alpha spheres)

effective_parameters.as_written: drop if n_vertices < min_pock_nb_asph || pasph < (refine_min_apolar_asphere_prop || as_density < min_as_density)
effective_parameters.note: The parenthesised operand is a C logical OR (0 or 1), not a proportion. With -p 0.0 a pocket is dropped by this clause when as_density < 0.7 and its apolar alpha-sphere proportion is < 1. Recorded as written; not reinterpreted.

effective_parameters.used_ref: src/voronoi.c:646-673 (alpha sphere is apolar if >= this many of its 4 contact atoms have electronegativity < 2.8)
effective_parameters.note: Despite the long option name, this is the minimum number of apolar contact atoms for an alpha sphere to be apolar (help text src/fparams.c:1006-1008).
